mapper.select: SELECT p.plan_id AS planId, p.greenhouse_id AS greenhouseId, p.member_id AS memberId, p.standard_id AS standardId, p.plan_name AS planName, p.plan_status AS planStatus, p.planned_start_date AS plannedStartDate, p.planned_end_date AS plannedEndDate, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.actual_start_date AS actualStartDate, p.actual_end_date AS actualEndDate, p.end_reason AS endReason, g.greenhouse_name AS greenhouseName, c.crop_id AS cropId, c.crop_name AS cropName, c.variety_name AS varietyName, s.growth_stage AS growthStage FROM cultivation_plan p JOIN greenhouse g ON g.greenhouse_id = p.greenhouse_id JOIN crop_stage_standard s ON s.standard_id = p.standard_id JOIN crop c ON c.crop_id = s.crop_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.plan_id = #{planId}

SELECT plan_id AS planId, greenhouse_id AS greenhouseId, member_id AS memberId, standard_id AS standardId, plan_name AS planName, plan_status AS planStatus, planned_start_date AS plannedStartDate, planned_end_date AS plannedEndDate, created_at AS createdAt, actual_start_date AS actualStartDate, actual_end_date AS actualEndDate, end_reason AS endReason FROM cultivation_plan WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND member_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT plan_id AS planId, greenhouse_id AS greenhouseId, member_id AS memberId, standard_id AS standardId, plan_name AS planName, plan_status AS planStatus, planned_start_date AS plannedStartDate, planned_end_date AS plannedEndDate, created_at AS createdAt, actual_start_date AS actualStartDate, actual_end_date AS actualEndDate, end_reason AS endReason FROM cultivation_plan WHERE plan_id = #{planId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cultivation_plan WHERE greenhouse_id = #{greenhouseId} AND plan_status = '진행'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cultivation_plan (greenhouse_id, member_id, standard_id, plan_name, plan_status, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, created_at) VALUES (#{greenhouseId}, #{memberId}, #{standardId}, #{planName}, '미진행', #{plannedStartDate}, #{plannedEndDate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE cultivation_plan SET greenhouse_id = #{greenhouseId}, standard_id = #{standardId}, plan_name = #{planName}, planned_start_date = #{plannedStartDate}, planned_end_date = #{plannedEndDate} WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND plan_status = '미진행'
UPDATE cultivation_plan SET plan_status = '진행', actual_start_date = #{actualStartDate} WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND plan_status = '미진행'
UPDATE cultivation_plan SET plan_status = '종료', actual_end_date = #{actualEndDate}, end_reason = #{endReason} WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND plan_status = '진행'
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cultivation_diary WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND worked_at >= #{to}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM greenhouse_environment_history WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND measured_at >= #{to}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM greenhouse_issue WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND occurred_at >= #{to})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cultivation_plan WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND plan_status = '미진행' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cultivation_diary d WHERE d.plan_id = cultivation_plan.plan_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM greenhouse_environment_history h WHERE h.plan_id = cultivation_plan.plan_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM greenhouse_issue i WHERE i.plan_id = cultivation_plan.plan_id)
mapper.select: SELECT d.diary_id AS diaryId, d.plan_id AS planId, d.worked_at AS workedAt, d.created_at AS createdAt, d.growth_stage AS growthStage, d.updated_at AS updatedAt, d.stage_change_reason AS stageChangeReason, p.plan_name AS planName, g.greenhouse_name AS greenhouseName, c.crop_name AS cropName, c.variety_name AS varietyName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cultivation_diary_task t WHERE t.diary_id = d.diary_id) AS taskCount FROM cultivation_diary d JOIN cultivation_plan p ON p.plan_id = d.plan_id JOIN greenhouse g ON g.greenhouse_id = p.greenhouse_id JOIN crop_stage_standard s ON s.standard_id = p.standard_id JOIN crop c ON c.crop_id = s.crop_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND d.diary_id = #{diaryId}

SELECT d.diary_id AS diaryId, d.plan_id AS planId, d.worked_at AS workedAt, d.created_at AS createdAt, d.growth_stage AS growthStage, d.updated_at AS updatedAt, d.stage_change_reason AS stageChangeReason FROM cultivation_diary d JOIN cultivation_plan p ON p.plan_id = d.plan_id WHERE d.diary_id = #{diaryId} AND p.member_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cultivation_diary WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND worked_at >= #{from} AND worked_at < #{to}

SELECT diary_id AS diaryId, plan_id AS planId, worked_at AS workedAt, created_at AS createdAt, growth_stage AS growthStage, updated_at AS updatedAt, stage_change_reason AS stageChangeReason FROM cultivation_diary WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY worked_at, diary_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cultivation_diary (plan_id, worked_at, created_at, growth_stage, stage_change_reason) VALUES (#{planId}, #{workedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{growthStage}, #{stageChangeReason})
mapper.update: UPDATE cultivation_diary SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} AND plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cultivation_diary WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cultivation_diary_task t WHERE t.diary_id = cultivation_diary.diary_id)
mapper.select: SELECT task_id AS taskId, diary_id AS diaryId, task_type AS taskType, task_name AS taskName, task_time AS taskTime, task_status AS taskStatus, task_content AS taskContent FROM cultivation_diary_task WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} ORDER BY task_time, task_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cultivation_diary_task (diary_id, task_type, task_name, task_time, task_status, task_content) VALUES (#{diaryId}, #{taskType}, #{taskName}, #{taskTime}, #{taskStatus}, #{taskContent})
mapper.update: UPDATE cultivation_diary_task SET task_type = #{taskType}, task_name = #{taskName}, task_time = #{taskTime}, task_status = #{taskStatus}, task_content = #{taskContent} WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cultivation_diary_task WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
